title: Find First and Last Position
statement:
Given a sorted array `nums` that may contain duplicates and a `target`, return the starting and ending positions of `target`.
If target is not found, return `[-1, -1]`.
Your algorithm must run in O(log n) time.
hints: Run binary search twice: once for the leftmost index, once for the rightmost.
When you find target while seeking the left edge, keep searching left (high = mid - 1).
When seeking the right edge, keep searching right (low = mid + 1).
